name: preset-knob-top-k-a
purpose: Preset knob "top_k" at value A (samplers). One member of the browser-equivalent generate request differs between the -a and -b scenarios; the provider-wire differential then proves Node(A)==Go(A), Node(B)==Go(B), and the pair test proves the pinned captures discriminate. Kind: discriminating.
stage1Boundary: Stage 1 validates the backend -> provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly (including the frontend's consumption of preset/settings fields) happens before the route is reached and is NOT covered here; a green provider-wire capture is not evidence of preset-level equivalence, and every knob here is classified in docs/preset-semantics.md against the surface that proves its frontend half (or declares that half unmeasured).

tier2.reason: The mock listens on an ephemeral loopback port, so the authority is not a property of either backend.
tier2.harnessSource: tools/mock-provider/main.go: --port 0 asks the kernel for a free port, so the authority is not stable

tier2.rule: value replaced with Bearer <redacted>, presence and scheme preserved
tier2.reason: The scenario supplies a synthetic key; the header's presence and scheme are the contract, the value is not.

tier2.rule: the mock authority is replaced with <mock> before hashing
tier2.reason: The mock listens on an ephemeral loopback port, so the authority is not a property of either backend. The rest of the body is compared byte for byte through the digest.

tier3.reason: It is a measurement of elapsed wall-clock time, so it differs on every run and no backend can match it; the value is a duration, not a contract.
